entries.zh: 隔（指人、物彼此分离、相隔开）
entries.en: to separate oneself, to divide apart; to be set apart

entries.zh: 隔開（把原先连在一起的东西隔断、分开）
entries.en: to separate things that were joined together; to part, to divide up
entries.notes: 西语原文 "apartarse los fandar juntos" 拼写残乱（fandar 非通行西语词），义从汉字「隔開」与闽南语 kui⁶-kin⁶-loan 组合推断

entries.zh: 隔斷（隔断、断绝联系，不再来往）
entries.en: to cut off, to break off (so as not to return or reunite again)

entries.zh: 隔遠（相隔很远、远远分开）
entries.en: to be far apart, to separate by a great distance

entries.zh: 離開（离开、离去）
entries.en: to leave, to go away, to depart

entries.zh: 離遠（远离、远远离开）
entries.en: to depart far away, to go off at a great distance

entries.zh: 離家鄉（离开家乡、离乡背井；亦指离开自己的职分岗位）
entries.en: to leave one's hometown; to depart from one's post or place
entries.notes: 西语 "apartarse de su cargo puesto"（离开职位岗位）与汉字「離家鄉」义有出入，取两者兼顾释义

entries.zh: 擇開（拨开、拣开，把混杂的东西分开拣出）
entries.en: to pick apart, to sort out and separate (things mixed together)
entries.notes: 西语词头残乱（"bos de fan comos los que se canbia rea"），义主要依汉字「擇開」与闽南语 pái-khuí 推定

entries.zh: 走開（走开、躲开，从中间走开让出位置）
entries.en: to go away, to step aside, to get out of the way

entries.zh: 解邪（脱离邪僻、离开不良生活；改邪归正）
entries.en: to turn away from evil, to abandon a bad or wicked way of life
entries.notes: 西语 "apartarse de la mala vida"（脱离恶的生活）与「解邪」互证；马尼拉天主教劝化语境义

entries.zh: 爬開（爬着挪开、手脚并用爬离）
entries.en: to crawl away, to creep apart (as insects or animals scurrying off)
entries.notes: 西语词头残乱且提及 banca/dinero（钱凳、钱财）与 escarbandos，与汉字「爬開」难以完全对上，释义存疑

entries.zh: 測可開去（侧身让开、避开走开）
entries.en: to step aside, to move off to one side, to give way
entries.notes: 汉字「測可開去」疑为「側/側身開去」之讹写；西语 "apartarse los nabios"（让开鼻子/身体）拼写残乱，释义存疑

entries.zh: 測落下去（侧身落下、坠下去；东西落下散开）
entries.en: to fall away or drop down; to sink apart below
entries.notes: 西语 "apartarse el grauio detriessa" 拼写残乱（疑指 gravio/triesa 或银两成块散落），义依「測(側)落下去」与闽南语 tsê-ló-hó-khú 推定，存疑

entries.zh: 辨開（辩论中分开、争辩时各执一词分开来辩）
entries.en: to dispute apart, to take separate sides in an argument; to distinguish apart
entries.notes: 西语 "apartarse en la diputa"（在争辩中分开/分辩）与「辨開」互证，具体歧义处（辨 vs 辩）保留

entries.zh: 阻隔（隔在中间使之阻隔、分处不同的房间或处所）
entries.en: to block off, to keep apart; to lodge in separate rooms (pieza)
entries.notes: 西语 "apartarse en diversa pieza"（分住不同房间）与「阻隔」互证；pieza 17 世纪义为房间/处所

entries.zh: 分（分开、分给、各自分开）
entries.en: to divide, to part, to distribute apart

entries.zh: 分拆（拆散分开、撕裂拆开）
entries.en: to break apart by tearing, to split up, to pull asunder

entries.zh: 分開（分开、使分离）
entries.en: to separate, to part, to divide apart

entries.zh: 分散（原本在一起的人散开、分散四方）
entries.en: to scatter, to disperse (those who were together); to disband

entries.zh: 分離（分离、离拆，彼此分开不再同处）
entries.en: to separate, to part from one another, to split off
entries.notes: 西语 "abtraparse" 为残缺拼写（疑 detacharse/ distraerse），义由汉字「分離」与闽南语 pun-lī 明确

entries.zh: 研熱（研磨生热、碾磨发热；研磨研热而成）
entries.en: to grind (so as to) heat up; pounded and made hot; to grate or pound apart into heat
entries.notes: 西语 "apartate & hace calor"（分开便发热）与汉字「研熱」及闽南语 gî-ê-jie 关系不明，疑原稿潦草致读法分歧，释义存疑

entries.zh: 擇開去（拣开拿开、拨开拿走）
entries.en: to pick apart and carry away, to take off or aside; to pick out and remove
entries.notes: 西语仅 "apartase"，汉字「擇開去」疑亦为「揀開去」类讹写，义从闽南语组合推定
